user_query: My friends and I are planning a trip to multiple countries, and we need to know the timezones of these countries. Can you provide us with a list of countries and their respective timezones? This will help us synchronize our activities and avoid any scheduling conflicts.

TaskList.description: Gather a list of specified countries for the trip.
Retrieve the timezones for the specified countries.
Compile the list of countries and their respective timezones into a formatted document.
